articles.title: Bullish beats revenue estimates as institutional services offset sluggish spot crypto volumes
articles.snippet: Bullish’s institutional focus may have shielded the company from the decline in activity experienced by rivals catering to retail traders and offers some insight to its revenue beat.

articles.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

articles.title: Sanctions fears loom over Russia’s regulated crypto trading launch
articles.snippet: Russia’s crypto trading rollout faces uncertainty as companies weigh sanctions exposure, while Moscow Exchange prepares to launch crypto trading in December.

articles.title: Fed’s Waller cites Binance hack in warning over tokenized finance
articles.snippet: Fed Governor Christopher Waller questioned who bears responsibility for fraud, compromised keys and failed transactions as traditional financial assets move onto blockchains.

articles.title: Google's Genie 4 Is Here, Letting Ultra Subscribers Build AI Worlds in Real Time
articles.snippet: Google's Genie 4 lets Ultra subscribers reshape interactive scenes while exploring them, complete with sound and dialogue, as Project Genie adds longer sessions and new community creation and sharing tools.
